highlights:
# Hyperbolic Raises $30M Series A-1 led by Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan’s Walden Catalyst

By Dan Lennox October 28, 2026 Updated: October 29, 2026 No Comments 5 Mins Read

San Francisco AI infrastructure startup Hyperbolic has raised $30 million in a Series A-1 round led by Walden Catalyst. Walden Catalyst is the venture firm founded by Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan and former Samsung president Young Sohn.

The round, announced on October 27, 2026, brings Hyperbolic’s total funding to $50 million. Dell Technologies Capital, General Catalyst, Vista Equity Partners and Cambium Capital also took part.

Hyperbolic sells software that lets AI companies buy, manage and run computing power across many GPU cloud providers from one place. The company did not disclose its valuation.

| Developers on platform | More than 250,000 |

...

Hyperbolic raised a $7 million seed round in July 2024, led by Polychain Capital and Lightspeed Faction, CoinDesk reported.

In December 2024, it raised a $12 million Series A led by Variant and Polychain Capital, bringing total funding to $20 million, Decrypt reported.
